name: ASLIB-WT
description: Replication archive for the paper Constraint programming and matheuristics for the RCPSP with alternative subgraphs under makespan and weighted tardiness objectives (Z. Hanzálek, L. Radovanský, J. Charvát). Contains: (1) ASLIB-WT, a new benchmark of 600 RCPSP-AS instances with a weighted-tardiness objective, the first of its kind; (2) certified optima for ASLIB-0 — the best makespan and its optimality status for each of the 36,000 instances of the public ASLIB-0 benchmark, 33,639 of them proved optimal; (3) the CP solvers for OR-Tools CP-SAT, IBM CP Optimizer and OptalCP, the ASLIB-WT generator, and a destroy-and-repair LNS matheuristic; (4) the complete per-instance results behind every table and figure of the paper, including full solve traces. The ASLIB-0 instances and the published heuristic baselines are not redistributed here; see README.md inside the archive for details and for the layout of all files.
